item.name: 02 - Authentication & User Management
item.description: Cryptographic JWT token issuance, user registration, OTP email/mobile verification, password recovery, and session revocation.

item.name: 02.1 - Login / Obtain JWT Access Token (Demo User)

request.description:
### Obtain JWT Access Token (Demo User)
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/token`
**Authentication**: None
**Request Body**: `{"demo_user": true}`
**Purpose**: Issues an RFC 7519 cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 JWT bearer token for the seeded demo user.
**Automation**: Automatically extracts `access_token` and saves it to `{{accessToken}}`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description:
### Login With Credentials
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (alias of `/token`)
**Authentication**: None
**Request Body**: Email and password.
**Purpose**: Authenticates credentials against bcrypt hash and issues access token.

exec: pm.test('Login response code is handled', function () {

request.description:
### Register New Investor Account
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/register`
**Authentication**: None
**Request Body**: `email`, `password`.
**Purpose**: Creates user in PostgreSQL, marks `email_verified=false`, and returns session token.

### Request Verification OTP
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/request-verification`
**Authentication**: None
**Request Body**: `recipient`, `code_type` (`email_verification` or `mobile_verification`).
**Purpose**: Generates unforgeable 6-digit cryptographic OTP valid for 15 minutes.
**Automation**: Captures `demo_code` into `{{otpCode}}`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description:
### Verify OTP Code
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/verify-code`
**Authentication**: None
**Request Body**: `recipient`, `code_type`, `code`.
**Purpose**: Verifies OTP code and sets `email_verified=true` or `mobile_verified=true`.

### Forgot Password
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password`
**Authentication**: None
**Request Body**: `{"email": "..."}`
**Purpose**: Initiates password recovery and generates 6-digit reset code.
**Automation**: Captures `demo_code` into `{{resetCode}}`.

response.name: 200 OK - Reset Code Generated

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 07 - Portfolio Creation & Optimization
item.description: End-to-end portfolio generation via LangGraph agent, deterministic SLSQP solver, whole-share integer rounding, and benchmark backtesting.

request.description:
### Generate Portfolio Recommendation
**Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/portfolio-generation-requests`
**Authentication**: Bearer Token required
**Status Code**: `201 Created`
**Processing Triggered**:
1. LangGraph orchestrator runs autonomous research nodes.
2. Risk tier suitability checked against loss capacity.
3. SLSQP optimizer minimizes risk variance under SEBI constraints (max 25% single-stock, max 40% sector).
4. Whole-share integer rounding allocates exact shares at live NSE prices, preserving unallocated cash.
5. Mathematical validation gate runs and records results in PostgreSQL.
**Automation**: Captures `portfolio_id`, `portfolio_version_id`, and `generation_request_id` for downstream requests.
